evidence.quote: Public connections instead follow the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize a connection to interact with a workspace.
Personal access tokens (PATs) are created directly by a Notion user in the Developer portal
include the installation access token in the Authorization header with every API request
The fastest way to start building is the Quickstart — create a personal access token, make your first API request, and see a new page appear in your workspace in under two minutes.
Notion MCP is a remote MCP server hosted by Notion.

result.notes: Personal access tokens are self-serve and free, obtainable in minutes via the Developer portal without approval. Public (multi-workspace) integrations use OAuth2 but do require a review step before distribution; internal integrations need no review. Bearer-token header scheme documented explicitly. Official Notion-hosted MCP server confirmed on developers.notion.com/docs/mcp, plus a highly-starred official GitHub repo (makenotion/notion-mcp-server).
result.one_liner: Notion is a workspace/notes/wiki and project-management tool with a REST API for pages, blocks, databases, and users.
